name: dashboard_userdefault
label: User Default Dashboard Table
description: The user default dashboard table is used for related queries and report queries related to dashboarding.

fields.name: dashboard_id
fields.description: Dashboard unique identifier, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: user_uuid
fields.description: User_uuid, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the dashboard_id, user_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: uk_user_uuid
indexes.description: Unique index covering the user_uuid field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
